fact_check.claim: March 15 (application, fee or waiver, portfolio) and April 15 (all other materials); fall 2027 = 2027 dates
fact_check.note: Brief row 'First deadline'/'Second deadline'; also re-read on https://admissions.cornell.edu/apply/transfer-applicants.

fact_check.claim: $85 fee; waiver automatic, no documents
fact_check.note: Page confirms $85 and automatic waiver with no documentation.

fact_check.claim: College Report: official at current school completes it, requested in Applicant Portal; confirms academic and disciplinary standing
fact_check.note: Confirmed on both Cornell pages. 'Usually registrar or dean' is the page's own hedged gloss, not a hard fact.

fact_check.claim: Academic Evaluation from instructor of a full-credit college course; out of school 2+ years may use personal or employer recommendation
fact_check.note: Confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Mid-Term Report: you list spring courses with official or estimated grades; written explanation if no grade; ILR by March 15 if possible, no later than April 15
fact_check.note: Admissions page confirms the report content; ILR timing is in the brief.

fact_check.claim: Essay 250 to 650 words; prompt 'How does continuing your education at a new institution help you achieve your future goals?'
fact_check.note: Exact prompt and limits confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Portfolio/design/resume/interview by program (Art, Fashion Design, Landscape Architecture portfolios; Architecture portfolio plus interview; DEA and FDM design supplement; Fashion Design design index; AEM and Hotel resume; Engineering course description form after admission)
fact_check.note: All match the admissions page list.

fact_check.claim: SAT and ACT neither required nor expected; AP/IB/A-Level self-reported in Common App Academic History
fact_check.note: Confirmed on both the admissions page and the enrollment FAQ.

fact_check.claim: Non-English documents need official translation; teacher or school official may translate
fact_check.note: Confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Decisions roll late April through June
fact_check.note: Confirmed on both pages. Hotel May and June figure is in the Hotel School page the brief cites.

fact_check.claim: Bachelor's degree holders are not eligible as transfers
fact_check.note: Page says they cannot enroll for a second bachelor's degree; the page's paraphrase is tight enough.

fact_check.claim: About a quarter of transfers come from community colleges; no preference by school type
fact_check.note: Confirmed ('roughly a quarter'); also brief.

fact_check.claim: Admitted transfers generally have 3.3 or better; coursework and essays matter most; main factors are the essay/Writing Supplement, current academics, professor recommendations
fact_check.note: Confirmed. 'First among' ordering matches the FAQ's list order.

fact_check.claim: GPA markers: AAP 2.7, CALS 3.0 (3.5 Biological Sciences), most ILR admits 3.4+, Engineering no minimum
fact_check.note: Brief rows for each college; trusted.

fact_check.claim: CSS Profile and FAFSA due March 15, 2027; FAFSA opened October 1, 2026
fact_check.note: Not in brief; the finaid page confirms both dates for fall 2027 transfers.

fact_check.claim: CSS Profile fee waived for adjusted gross income up to $100,000
fact_check.note: Confirmed. The page limits it to U.S. students; the page says it under the community-college reader block for US aid, which matches.

fact_check.claim: CSS Profile code 2098; international applicants who miss it cannot receive undergraduate aid later; admission is need-aware
fact_check.note: Code, March 15, 2027 deadline and need-aware confirmed. The brief states the no-later-aid consequence. The source says the CSS Profile is required at admission of applicants seeking grant aid at any point during their studies, so the page's wording is a fair paraphrase.

fact_check.claim: English proficiency minimum competitive: TOEFL iBT 100 (before Jan 2026; 5.0 new scale after), IELTS Academic 7.5, Duolingo 130; four years at English-language school may be exempt; self-reported scores for initial review, official after admission
fact_check.note: All values confirmed.

fact_check.claim: 23 transfer veterans entered Cornell in fall 2026
fact_check.note: Brief carries 23 with the Chronicle source.

fact_check.claim: Example: 650 + 650 + 350 = 1,650 words across three ILR prompts
fact_check.note: Recomputed: 650+650+350 = 1,650. Prompt lengths per the ILR fall 2026 guidelines in the brief.

fact_check.claim: ILR three essays, no interviews; ILR junior course list; four full-time semesters and 60 credits at Cornell; ILR no credit for work or military training
fact_check.note: ILR rows in the brief.

fact_check.claim: CALS bars more than four semesters at a four-year school; Hotel bars current juniors/seniors; Engineering ineligible life/work/military experience; AAP no external B.Arch. transfers fall 2027
